gloss: the real culprit; the true criminal

definitions.gloss: the real culprit; the true perpetrator
definitions.explanation: The person who actually committed a crime, as opposed to someone wrongly suspected or falsely accused.

examples.japanese: {真犯人|しんはんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{捕|つか}まっていない→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The real culprit has not yet been caught.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真犯人|しんはんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}し{示|しめ}した→指し示す：16947_sashishimesu⟧。
examples.english: New evidence pointed to the true criminal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疑|うたが}われている→疑う：01889_utagau⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{真犯人|しんはんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逃|に}げて→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: While an innocent person was under suspicion, the real culprit got away.

notes:
Compound of the prefix ⟦{真|しん}→真：28884_shin⟧ (true, real) + ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧ (criminal, culprit). The ⟦{真|しん}→真：28884_shin⟧ contrasts the actual offender with a suspect or scapegoat, so the word is common in mysteries and crime reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真犯人|しんはんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch the real culprit
- {真犯人|しんはんにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the true criminal comes to light
- {真犯人|しんはんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: the real culprit is someone else

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧: suspect — someone suspected, not yet proven guilty
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧: culprit; offender — the general word, without the "as opposed to a suspect" nuance
